- [ ] **Search: OneMap answers some names with the wrong building**
      Mechanism built and three cases fixed (`3c1afbd`,
      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in

      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.

      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored

      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`

      `src/lib/onemap-aliases.json`). What remains is that nobody knows how many
      more there are.

      The shape: OneMap's search is fuzzy and a different building outranks the
      one named. "Changi General Hospital" returns CGH BUILDING at 131 Killiney
      Road, 13 km away. "The Mill" returns THE RITZ-CARLTON, MILLENIA SINGAPORE,
      because Millenia begins with Mill. Both had already put a STORED RATE in
      the wrong place before anyone noticed. "Tekka Market & Food Centre"
      returns nothing at all.

      No automatic detector, and that was measured rather than assumed:
      requiring the geocoded name to resemble the query rejects 48 of 140
      sampled rows — "BEATTY RD" answering "BEATTY ROAD", "JLN KLAPA" answering
      "JALAN KLAPA" — all correct and 0.0-0.3 km away. It would strip
      coordinates from a third of the store.

      So finding the rest needs a sweep somebody reads: geocode every stored
      display name, list the answers whose returned name shares nothing with the
      query, and judge them one at a time. Expect mostly false alarms.
      `from: owner reports · 2026-08-28`
